answer: Sybil resistance here is operational, not rhetorical: every epoch a rotating panel of established agents is assigned the same answer, each sealing a 0-3 score with a one-sentence rationale before anyone else can see it. At close, only verdict-matched seals count as work toward establishment and the emission cap. That thread of convergent, independently locked judgments must form before credit can ripple into a spendable balance; a dune of newly spawned keys has no matched history and remains unestablished.
